encoder_bridge.selection: first eight original source indices in the registered role
encoder_bridge.failure_policy: stop before controllers and final labels; no silent cross-runtime feature substitution

projection.method: original label-independent Gaussian QR with fixed diagonal-R signs

selection_tie_rule: first exact minimum in the frozen action order, numpy.argmin; no tolerance-based selection
question: Does a causal finite observation/input history or the existing optimizer summary repair multi-step projection on a model-independent action pool, and transfer to new source components?
action_scope: new fixed Rademacher directions independent of either optimizer; h*u physical norm 0.002, within the original coordinate box; equal nonzero effort for directional ranking
common_objective: original V3 direct_soft_total at H8 with unchanged h, effort and retention anchor
history_definition: causal predicted loss windows plus explicit known past input forcing; never future observed loss; all arms share complete-state/Jacobian calibration
moment_definition: existing reference C_extended: current loss, old loss, current gradient dot momentum, old gradient dot momentum
source_owner_policy: prepare and consume only source_owner_directory/data; create-only preparation and final access; changing run, feature or evaluation output directories does not authorize a new copy of this cohort; preserve the owner directory after every failure
source_scope_reason: V3 exhausted eligible June health sources and left only two August health components; source feasibility fixes scope before new outcomes; no silent reuse of exposed final labels
reserve_policy: all unselected eligible component identities remain reserved; do not emit their labels/titles into the V4 final payload or use them for this run
training_scope: reuse exact V3 train/probe features and train labels to rebuild the six fixed trajectories; not independent new training tasks; all V3 opened outcomes are development only
freeze_order: source-only new cohort with exclusions and reserve IDs
all prediction maps and chosen actions sealed
all real action paths and heldout predictions sealed
mandatory_pre_unseal_audit: exact pre-execution candidate file census; no missing predictions or post-execution files
480 reconstructed common warmup and current-anchor optimizer steps
2448 replayed branch optimizer steps and receipts
probe observations recomputed from every replayed state
all final predictions recomputed from saved parameters
mechanism_metrics: per-step current and old response MAE
Kendall tau-b on 16 equal-radius nonzero actions
regret of each predicted minimum over the full 17-action pool
mechanism_scope: exact finite census at 18 correlated anchors from six fixed trajectories; no independent-task significance claim

external_primary.passing_rule: adjusted interval upper endpoint strictly below zero

external_secondary: all arms, zero and Full; new old_test_v4 retention and accuracy; report point estimates only, do not replace six primary comparisons
uncertainty: class-stratified paired source bootstrap after equal averaging of the three fixed seeds; Bonferroni percentile intervals across six comparisons; no training-seed population or finite-sample coverage guarantee
failure_policy: retain every anchor/action/arm failure; missing registered paths invalidate associated comparisons; no fallback, selective rerun, method change or holdout reuse after final access
cost_scope: charge shared full-state reference once per anchor and separately report all closure map builds, all 306 branch executions, features, auditing, bytes and wall/CPU; no energy or target-hardware certification
